_about: Generated by tests/Unit/Report/SiteCheckImpactCasesTest.php from real stored results; do not edit by hand.

home_newly_failing.description: Homepage HTTP 500 twice after the update (verified), REST passed at both.

rest_newly_failing.description: REST API invalid JSON twice after the update, homepage passed at both.

both_newly_failing.description: Homepage HTTP 500 and REST API HTTP 500 with an empty body, both twice.

home_redirect.description: Homepage loaded before, redirected in both requests after.

home_timeouts.description: Homepage: no response within 10 seconds, twice.

home_incomplete.description: Homepage verified but without the end-of-page marker, twice.

home_not_inspected.description: Homepage too large to inspect before and after: not compared.

home_unverified_500.description: Homepage HTTP 500 twice without the verification marker.

both_passed.description: Both checks passed before and after.

failing_both.description: Homepage HTTP 500 before and after: not a new failure.

unconfirmed.description: Homepage HTTP 500 once, then passed on the retry: inconclusive.

no_baseline.description: No baseline for either check (none taken in this login session).

after_not_reported.description: Both AFTER runs started but were never reported (page closed).

overlapping_update.description: Another update ran before the AFTER results were accepted.

disabled.description: Site checks were disabled for this update.

historical.description: Recorded before site checks existed (no site check columns).

one_unavailable.description: Homepage passed at both; the REST baseline started before the update but finished after it began.

pending.description: Both AFTER runs claimed 10 seconds ago, results not reported yet.

pending_with_finding.description: REST API failing already reported; the homepage AFTER result may still arrive.

redirect_disappeared.description: Homepage redirected before, loaded directly after.

redirect_then_failure.description: Homepage redirected before, HTTP 500 twice after: a change, not a newly failing check.
